# BaseBridgeAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/base/BaseBridgeAdapter.sol)

**Inherits:**
[CrossChainConfigManaged](../contracts/cross-chain-config-managed.md), ReentrancyGuard, ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
BaseBridgeAdapter

Abstract base contract for cross-chain bridge adapters

Handles mapping between chain IDs and bridge-specific protocol IDs,
managing trusted source/destination relationships, and encoding/decoding payloads.


## State Variables
### THIS_CHAIN
The chain ID of the current blockchain


```solidity
uint16 public immutable THIS_CHAIN
```


### chainToExternalId
Mapping of supported chains to their external bridge protocol IDs


```solidity
mapping(uint16 chainId => uint32 externalId) public chainToExternalId
```


### externalIdToChainId
Reverse mapping of external bridge protocol IDs to chain IDs


```solidity
mapping(uint32 externalId => uint16 chainId) public externalIdToChainId
```

### onlyTrustedDestination

Ensures that governance has registered a trusted peer adapter for `dstChain` in the CrossChainRegistry.

This check validates that the destination chain has been authorized by governance through the registry.
It does NOT check whether this adapter knows how to translate chain IDs to bridge-specific external IDs—that
validation is handled by the internal external ID mapping (chainToExternalId).
This creates a two-layer security model:
1. Registry check: "Am I allowed to talk to that peer?" (governance authorization)
2. External ID mapping: "Do I know how to talk to the bridge on that chain?" (technical capability)


```solidity
modifier onlyTrustedDestination(uint16 dstChain) ;
```

## Events
### ExternalIdMapped
Emitted when a chain external ID mapping is added


```solidity
event ExternalIdMapped(uint16 indexed chainId, uint32 indexed externalId);
```

### ExternalIdUnmapped
Emitted when a chain external ID mapping is removed


```solidity
event ExternalIdUnmapped(uint16 indexed chainId, uint32 indexed externalId);
```

## Errors
### UntrustedDestinationChain
Error thrown when destination chain peer is not trusted by governance


```solidity
error UntrustedDestinationChain(uint16 chainId);
```

### UntrustedSourceAdapter
Error thrown when source adapter is not trusted


```solidity
error UntrustedSourceAdapter(address srcAdapter, uint16 srcChain);
```

### InvalidAmount
Error thrown when the amount is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidAmount();
```

### InvalidSourceChainId
Error thrown when the source chain ID is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidSourceChainId();
```

### ChainIdTooLarge
Error thrown when chain ID exceeds uint16 max value


```solidity
error ChainIdTooLarge(uint256 chainId);
```

### Unauthorized
Thrown when a call is made by an unauthorized address


```solidity
error Unauthorized();
```

### InvalidMessage
Error thrown when the message is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidMessage();
```

### InvalidParams
Error thrown when invalid parameters are provided


```solidity
error InvalidParams();
```
